newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila lowers 5-day rrp rates, hikes other rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila lowers 5-day rrp rates, hikes other rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday it had lowered its five-day reverse repo rate to 11.0 percent from 13.0 percent.

It raised its one-month reverse repo rate to 11.0 percent from 10.5 percent, two-month reverse repo rate to 11.125 percent from 10.5625 percent, and six-month reverse repo rate to 11.625 percent from 10.875 percent.
The special series 90-day Treasury bill rate was kept unchanged at 10.9 percent.
Central Bank officials were not immediately available to comment on the rate adjustments.
The reduction in the five-day reverse repo rate came minutes after the Central Bank lowered its overnight borrowing and lending rates by two percentage points each.
The increase in other reverse repo rates came three days after the Treasury bill rates inched higher at Monday's weekly auction.
The Central Bank usually follows the rate movement in the results of the weekly T-bill auction.
